title: A common Borel reference orientation for countably many IMReps
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, and R_i = (M_i, θ_i, ξ_i) (i ∈ ℕ) IMReps in U. Put N := ⋃_i M_i and assume Hⁿ(N ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U. Then there are a strongly measurable η : ℝ^P → Λ_n(ℝ^P) (MultiVector P n) and measurable s_i : ℝ^P → ℝ (i ∈ ℕ) with s_i(x) ∈ {1, −1} for all i and x, such that: (a) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ N there is a linear subspace Q with HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n N x Q and IsUnitOrientationOf (η(x)) Q; (b) for every i, ξ_i(x) = s_i(x)·η(x) for Hⁿ-a.e. x ∈ M_i.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (R : ℕ → IMRep U n), IsOpen U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] ((⋃ i, (R i).carrier) ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∃ (η : Euclid P → MultiVector P n) (s : ℕ → Euclid P → ℝ), StronglyMeasurable η ∧ (∀ i, Measurable (s i)) ∧ (∀ i x, s i x = 1 ∨ s i x = -1) ∧ (∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (⋃ i, (R i).carrier)), ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (⋃ i, (R i).carrier) x Q ∧ IsUnitOrientationOf (η x) Q) ∧ ∀ i, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (R i).carrier), (R i).orient x = s i x • η x
